description: Expanded benchmark suite covering advanced hydrology, imagery, topology, surface interpolation, and complex multi-step pipelines.

test_cases.prompt: Import points.geojson vector features, extract the point where cat=1, and generate concentric circular buffer areas around it from 250 to 2000 meters in 250-meter increments.
Compute shaded relief from the elevation raster with sun azimuth 315 and sun altitude 45.
Calculate univariate statistics including mean and standard deviation for the elevation raster.
Clean the road network vector by removing duplicate line segments and snapping nodes with a 1-meter threshold.
Add a new double precision column named area_sqm to the parcels attribute table.
Compute travel cost surface from a starting point raster across a friction surface raster.
Calculate NDVI vegetation index from red and near-infrared reflectance rasters.
Dissolve adjacent parcel polygons that share the same zoning code attribute.
Set raster cells with values below 0 to NULL in the bathymetry raster.
Reclassify landcover raster into broad categories using reclass rules.
Convert stream raster cells into vector line features.
Find the shortest route along a vector road network between points in layer 2.
Trace the least-cost drainage path flowline from a starting point over a cumulative cost raster.
Export the elevation raster map to an external GeoTIFF file elevation.tif.
Export the parcels vector map to a GeoPackage file parcels.gpkg.
Calculate flow accumulation and drainage direction from the elevation raster, then delineate stream network lines where accumulation exceeds 1000 cells.
Compute drainage direction from the elevation raster and delineate the subwatershed basin draining to outlet coordinate 640000,220000.
Populate the parcel vector polygons with their calculated area in square meters.
Import schools.shp, create a 500m buffer around schools, and select all residential buildings intersecting the buffer.
Filter forest polygons where canopy_density > 70 and export the result to dense_forest.geojson.
Patch northern_dem and southern_dem rasters together into a single elevation mosaic.
Calculate slope from elevation raster, reclassify slopes greater than 15 degrees into steep areas, and convert steep areas to vector polygons.
Calculate the minimum Euclidean distance from each cell to the nearest hospital vector points.
Calculate the average temperature per county by computing zonal statistics of temperature raster over county vector polygons.
Interpolate a continuous elevation surface raster from spot elevation vector points using regularized spline with tension.
Create an integer raster mask from urban_zones where code equals 5 to constrain subsequent raster processing.
Calculate the normalized difference water index using formula (green - nir) / (green + nir) via raster map calculation.
Find the nearest fire station vector point for each building vector point and record the distance in the attribute table.
Calculate the average of 12 monthly rainfall rasters rain_01 through rain_12 using raster series aggregation.
Segment adjacent clumps of contiguous cells in the classified forest raster into distinct unique polygon IDs.
